_help: Relative paths are inside the folder this file is in; full paths like C:/Users/you/Videos/transcripts also work. Use / or \\ in paths. Settings starting with _ are notes.
_prompts_help: prompts_folder: a folder with your own report_prompt.md and/or section_notes_prompt.md. Empty: the built-in prompts.
_runner_help: runner: the program that runs the models that don't set their own "runner": "lmstudio" or "ollama".
_server_url_help: server_url: the runner named by "runner" on another computer, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:1234 (LM Studio) or http://192.168.1.20:11434 (Ollama). Empty: on this computer, started and stopped as needed. Models on the other runner use it on this computer, and get no api_token.
_api_token_help: api_token: only if LM Studio's server has Require Authentication turned on, or for a proxy in front of Ollama. Empty: none, or for LM Studio the LM_API_TOKEN environment variable.
_models_help: default_model is used when --model isn't given. key = the model's key in its runner (run `lms ls` for LM Studio, `ollama list` for Ollama); runner (optional) = "lmstudio" or "ollama", else the runner setting; ctx = context size in tokens; sampling (optional) overrides temperature, top_p, top_k, min_p, repeat_penalty. Remove the model you don't use.

my-model.notes: Anything you like, e.g. which quantisation this is and how much VRAM it uses.

my-ollama-model.notes: To use this one, set default_model to "my-ollama-model" or pass --model my-ollama-model.
